'''Toru Nara''' (Japanese: '''奈良徹''' ''Nara Tōru'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Nara was born on May 7, 1980, in {{wp|Saitama, Saitama}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. He began his work on the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|DP}}, voicing [[Sinnoh]] [[Elite Four]] member [[Flint]], his best-known role in that work. Then, he voiced [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] [[Glenn]] and [[Nico]] in {{aniseries|BW}} and {{aniseries|XY}}, respectively. Nara is currently affiliated with Kenyu Office.
